Cobalt's net balance of 62037 matches my check: orders 172 and 175 total 64994, less the 2957 refund on order 175. All three balances match, so I'll record the first payout, acme for 11259.
Acme's payout of 11259 is recorded. Birch's net balance of 18633 matches my independent check, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (11259) and birch (18633) are recorded. Cobalt's net balance of 62037 matches my independent check (27875 + 37119 - 2957), so I'll record its payout to finish the batch.
